about_the_game:
A set of images: Hyperborean for the game "Lizards Must Die 2" is an additional context that turns the main characters into seasoned Hyperborean warriors. They appear in the guise of descendants of Perun, dressed in advanced armor from the time of Ancient Russia, forged by famous blacksmiths - Kyshtym dwarves. The lizards are running everywhere, and you can brag to your friends that you have extra money to buy skins for online games and enjoy the updated appearance of your characters.

The set includes clothes for the four main characters: Drochecheslav, Vseslav, Viktor and Mstislav. A unique armor and weapon shape is added for each character.
